prompts.title: Sketch and Splatter
prompts.prompt:
Create an 8K ultra-high-resolution mixed-media portrait illustration that blends photorealistic character rendering with expressive watercolor and architectural sketch techniques.
Face Matching & Identity Accuracy:
Match the exact facial structure from the reference image — same jawline definition, haircut length, skin tone, eye shape, and nose proportions.
Subject & Expression:
A confident individual with sharp, realistic facial features, detailed skin texture, and defined cheekbones. The expression is serious, focused, and contemplative, with a subtle furrow in the brow. The gaze is directed upward and off-camera, suggesting determination and forward vision.
Pose:
Chest-up portrait. The torso is angled slightly toward the viewer’s left while the head turns upward toward the right side of the frame. This twist in the shoulders and neck creates a dynamic, heroic stance.
Outfit:
She wears a short-puff-sleeve top with a brown and cream geometric batik-style pattern and a small decorative bow at the neckline. The Outfit is rendered with painterly shading and sketch-style cross-hatching that gradually dissolves into watercolor textures toward the lower part of the portrait.
Composition & Camera Angle:
Medium close-up (chest-up). Slight low-angle "hero shot" perspective that emphasizes the jawline and gives the subject a powerful presence. The subject is placed slightly off-center, leaving negative space around the head and shoulders.
Lighting:
Dramatic directional lighting from the upper-left side. The light highlights the forehead, nose bridge, and cheekbones while casting deeper shadows along the opposite side of the face and neck, creating strong contrast and depth.
Background & Artistic Style:
Clean white background with no physical environment. Behind the subject are expressive blue watercolor splashes, ink drips, and paint blooms forming an energetic halo. Thin architectural pencil construction lines and sketch marks intersect across the composition, adding structure and motion.
Artistic Medium & Texture:
A hybrid style combining photorealistic digital painting, loose watercolor washes, ink splatter effects, and raw sketch linework. The face remains highly detailed and realistic while the shoulders and lower areas transition into unfinished painterly strokes and abstract watercolor textures.
Color Palette:
Natural warm skin tones contrasted with a vibrant watercolor hues of blue against a bright white canvas.
Technical Details:
Ultra-detailed digital illustration, 8K resolution, sharp facial focus, painterly brush textures, watercolor bloom effects, ink splashes, architectural sketch lines, soft fade-out edges.
Aspect Ratio: 4:5

prompts.title: Cozy 3D Family Gathering
prompts.prompt:
Create a vertical 4:5 full-body family portrait in a premium high-quality stylized 3D animated illustration style. Use the uploaded family photo as the subject reference and keep each person clearly recognizable through their facial structure, hairstyle, glasses if present, age feel, and natural expression, while converting them into a polished cute 3D animated look. The rendering should feel rich, detailed, soft, and high-end, with natural skin shading, detailed hair strands, realistic fabric texture, and smooth cinematic polish. Avoid any plastic, waxy, toy-like, or cheap CGI appearance.
Camera Angle & Framing — Strict:

Use a clearly elevated high-angle camera view, as if the camera is positioned above the family and tilted downward toward them, not at eye level. This perspective must create the same playful visual effect as the reference: faces and upper bodies appear slightly larger, the floor and rug are visibly seen beneath them, and the full bodies taper naturally toward the feet. Keep the family large in the frame, filling most of the composition from top to bottom. Show everyone head to toe, but avoid loose framing, excess empty wall, or a front-facing formal portrait look.
Family Placement & Pose:

This prompt should work for any number of family members. Arrange them in a tight, affectionate cluster with a warm, joyful, close-family feel. If children are present, place them toward the center/front of the group, not pushed to the side. Adults should stand slightly behind or around them, with natural affectionate gestures such as arms resting around shoulders, backs, or waists. Everyone should look directly toward the camera with bright, genuine, happy smiles. The pose should feel lively, loving, and candid, not stiff, symmetrical, or studio-formal.
Character Design:

Use a cute premium animated character style with slightly oversized expressive eyes, softly rounded facial forms, fuller charming head proportions, rich voluminous hair, and lively joyful facial emotion. Keep the characters adorable and expressive, but still refined and elegant. Do not make them too realistic, flat, generic, or proportioned like ordinary humans in a simple front-facing poster.
Outfits:

Keep the outfit vibe connected to the input, but when clothing is too plain, refine it into modern, clean, stylish family-casual fashion similar to the reference image. Use tasteful pieces such as soft cardigans, knit sweaters, neat blouses, denim jackets, striped inner tops, fitted trousers, loafers, simple sneakers, or other contemporary everyday outfits. The clothing should look polished, age-appropriate, and visually coordinated without feeling overstyled.
Background & Doodles:

Place the family in a clean cozy indoor setting with a warm beige wall, light wooden floor, a simple cream rug with brown geometric border patterns, and a small softly blurred potted plant in one corner. Keep the room minimal and uncluttered. Around the family, add playful hand-drawn wall doodles using bold dark-brown linework with a few warm colored accents, including pink or red hearts, yellow stars, sparkle marks, small celebratory doodles, and a tiny sketched family drawing. Add clear handwritten speech bubbles such as “Yay!” and “Family!”, arranged around the subjects without covering any faces or bodies.
Color & Lighting:

Use rich, warm, cheerful colors like the reference image, not washed-out or dull tones. The scene should feel bright, cozy, inviting, and emotionally warm, with balanced accents of beige, cream, pink, denim blue, warm brown, black, and soft red/yellow doodle highlights. Use soft warm indoor lighting with gentle face highlights, natural shadows under the feet, subtle edge separation, and a polished premium finish.
Strict Result Goal:

The final image should closely follow the top-down camera angle, tight frame-filling composition, cute premium 3D proportions, rich warm color palette, playful doodle wall, minimal cozy background, and affectionate family energy, while preserving the uploaded family members’ recognizable identities and arrangement.
